purpose: Pre-experiment methodological crosswalk. This does not import historical theories or alter BHD hypotheses.

principles.route: derive the simplest concrete mechanism that could generate a BHD signature, then demand a decisive test
require a conventional/null explanation and invariance under admissible reparameterization and normalization
start from a precisely defined measurable quantity and its operational measurement limits
separate mathematical state/quantity from what the measurement protocol can physically establish
define state evolution/generative dynamics first, then derive the observable from the dynamics
